segments.context: Stumptown Coffee Roasters · United StatesFounder's BlendFounder's Blend is an organic chocolate-led daily-coffee candidate for drip, press and AeroPress. Stumptown's product detail calls it dark while its signature-blend collection calls it medium, and a 2026 independent sample is only one bag. Treat the roaster's vanilla, cocoa and honey words as a flavor direction, check the actual roast label, and start with a manageable whole-bean pack.Updated 2026-11-09 · Check current US whole-bean price at November 9, 2026
